info.name: Zero Slop API
info.description: Edit one draft through the same pipeline as Zero Slop MCP. Free shared capacity; no API key. Use synthetic drafts until you have reviewed your Postman workspace's sharing, history and sync settings. HTTP 200 is a pipeline outcome, not automatic approval. Set request timeout to 75000 ms and disable automatic redirects before sending real writing.

request.description: The running service generates its OpenAPI 3.1.2 contract from the schemas used by MCP and REST. This request sends no draft.

Synthetic example. Send one UTF-8 JSON body, at most 128 KiB. text is 1–20000 Unicode code points after trimming; audience is optional and at most 200 Unicode code points. Read status and note before using the result. No retries run in this collection.
